steps.title: Open /desk to view all sections
steps.narration: The Desk page now shows three new sections below Microscope Readiness. Each is collapsed (arrow points right). Let's expand them to see how ideas move through screening, testing, and validation.
steps.point_out: You see four section headers in order: Microscope Readiness, Scout Ledger, Walk-Forward, Validation Vault. Each arrow points right (collapsed).

steps.title: Expand Scout Ledger to see the screening record
steps.narration: Scout Ledger records every candidate idea that gets tested. Today it's empty—no ideas have been screened yet. Below that, Run History shows when screening runs happened.
steps.point_out: Scout Ledger opens. You see 'Ledger chain verification: ok', then 'No candidates ledgered.' (the honest empty state), then 'No scout runs recorded yet.' The enabled 'Run Screen' button sits below—we won't click it to avoid starting a long computation.

steps.title: Expand Walk-Forward to see diagnostic test sequences
steps.narration: Walk-Forward tests ideas against data they haven't seen before, in time order. Today one sequence exists. You can see the fold results and whether it passed or failed.
steps.point_out: Walk-Forward opens. You see 'Ledger chain verification: ok', then Fold Specs, then a sequence with its test results. The verdict line says whether it passed or was refused (and why).

steps.title: Expand Validation Vault to see the read-only record
steps.narration: Validation Vault holds data sealed away from research—untouched data to test a finished idea against. Today it's empty; no data has been sealed yet. This section is read-only; there are no controls to change anything here.
steps.point_out: Validation Vault opens. Two chain-verification lines appear: 'Shard ledger chain verification: ok' and 'Universe ledger chain verification: ok'. Below: 'No shards recorded.' and 'No universes registered.' No buttons anywhere—the section is read-only.

steps.title: Verify Microscope Readiness section was unaffected
steps.narration: Microscope Readiness sits above the three new sections. It still shows what it always has: the corpus facts (12 symbol-days, 18 datasets) and readiness metrics.
steps.point_out: Microscope Readiness opens and shows its tables unchanged. The three new sections sit cleanly below with no visual disruption.

steps.title: Navigate to /structure to check the other pages
steps.narration: The Structure page shows the tradable map for the corpus. This page didn't change—all the new work went only to /desk.
steps.point_out: /structure loads without error. The Tradable Map and comparison dropdown are visible.

steps.title: Navigate to Cockpit to confirm the main page stayed the same
steps.narration: The Cockpit shows the live tape chart. This page also stayed the same—all changes went to /desk.
steps.point_out: The Cockpit loads and the chart renders. No errors.
